Monsieur Cuisine Recipes is also includes sections for the maintenance and care of your food processor, along with a favourites section, where you can save the recipes for MCC that you like the most. 

Monsieur Cuisine Recipes is is a very intuitive, clean, and easy to use application that can get everyone working. 

Monsieur Cuisine Recipes is the best application with recipes from the food processor.
